transcript.text: I need to raise a blocking issue before we go any further. This morning while load-testing an unrelated ingestion worker, I confirmed that the queue service's standard mode can reorder report jobs during a broker failover. The provider's own documentation requires FIFO mode and a maximum batch size of exactly 50 for ordered report delivery. Our current design draft uses standard queue mode with a max batch size of 200, so it does not meet the ordering requirement. I haven't updated the architecture draft yet, but this needs to be addressed before production sign-off.
